status.label: Out
status.shortComment: Brown (back) won't play in Sunday's game against Atlanta.
status.longComment: Brown didn't practice throughout the week. While he has been ruled out for Week 2, it's unknown how much longer he will be out of commission. As a result, Aaron Hall and TeRah Edwards are both expected to receive more snaps versus the Falcons.

status.label: Questionable
status.shortComment: Jones (back) is listed as questionable for Sunday's game versus the Falcons.
status.longComment: Jones didn't suit up for the Week 1 loss to the Bears. Although he practiced in a limited capacity throughout the week, he's in danger of missing another contest Sunday. If Jones can't get on the field against Atlanta, Princely Umanmielen and Trevis Gipson would be in line for more snaps.
